build.buildCommand: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prod=false && pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter @inspectai/contracts build && pnpm --filter @inspectai/domain build && pnpm --filter @inspectai/storage build && pnpm --filter @inspectai/api build

deploy.startCommand: pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy && node apps/api/dist/main.js
